title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-132709)
description: CVE-2026-132709 is a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Wikimedia Foundation's MediaWiki Parsoid service. It involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, specifically in the TableFixups.php file. The vulnerability affects multiple versions of the parsoid service prior to certain fixed releases. The CVSS 5.3 score indicates a medium severity issue with network attack vector and user interaction required.
